description: This file defines the CellBorder class within the PhpSpreadsheet library for handling style borders in Xlsx files. It maps border style constants to their corresponding style codes and provides a method to retrieve style codes based on border objects.

classes.name: CellBorder
classes.description: Handles the mapping of border styles to style codes and provides functionality to retrieve style codes based on border instances.

methods.name: style
methods.description: Returns the style code corresponding to the provided Border object based on its border style.
